caption: Blank page? Turn it into a plan with a precise AI prompt. What will you try first today? #AIHomework #StudyTips #StudentLife #NaelBuildingBig

slides.title: Hook: Unfinished Homework
slides.body: You open the sheet, blank page stares back, and the timer ticks. Classic block.

slides.title: Recognition: The Block
slides.body: You copy-paste a prompt with no details, hoping the AI fills in.

slides.title: Bad Example: Weak Prompt
slides.body: Bad: 'Explain this.' for my homework, nothing else.

slides.title: Better Example: Copyable Prompt
slides.body: Better: 'Outline a 1-page biology essay for Grade 11: 3 main ideas, simple language, bullet list, and a short conclusion.'

slides.title: Payoff: Clear Output
slides.body: Example: 1) Cell cycle basics. 2) Mitosis stages simplified. 3) Quick conclusion with examples.

slides.title: Action: One Quick Task
slides.body: Copy the Better Prompt, run AI, check it lists 3 clear ideas in simple language; adjust if needed.

slides.title: Close: Takeaway and Share
slides.body: Sharper prompts save minutes and keep your grades steady. Save this template, share with friends who stall on homework.
